name: Radiant Triple Crush
name_jp: 耀光トリプルクラッシュ
effects:
7 single-target Lightning/Fire/Ice/NE magic attacks at Cap Break Level 1, En-Lightning Stack, En-Fire Stack or En-Ice Stack, Cap Break Level 1 & Crystal Mode to user
Crystal Mode: Black Magic Ability Boost, Dualcast Black Magic, Zero Hone Cost to Black Magic Abilities & 25% DEF/RES Pierce
Crystal Force I/II: 4 single-target Lightning/Fire/Ice/NE magic attacks at Cap Break Level 1, Instant Cast, [Cap Break Level 2, Black Magic Ability Damage +50%, Quick ATB & 50% DEF/RES Pierce] for 1 turn to user; After using Crystal Force II, chases with 2 single-target Lightning/Fire/Ice/NE Overflow magic attacks, Quick/Instant Black Magic 1 & Triple/Quadracast Black Magic 1 to user with at least 0/3 Mage I members in party
